findings.highlight: It’s probably clean since Sakura prepared it for me.
findings.evidenceJa: いつも桜が用意してくれてるんで、きっと清潔
findings.governingReading: Because Sakura always prepares the handkerchief for him, Shirou is confident it is surely clean.
findings.explanation: “Probably” weakens きっと and Shirou’s habitual trust in Sakura’s domestic care.

findings.highlight: my right hand feels a bit better.
findings.evidenceJa: 右腕は少しだけ楽になった。
findings.governingReading: The spell slightly eases Shirou’s injured right arm.
findings.explanation: The English narrows arm to hand and misstates the treated injury location.

findings.highlight: she’s so close to me
findings.evidenceJa: いま体が触れあうぐらい近くにいて
findings.governingReading: Rin is close enough that their bodies are touching.
findings.explanation: The English preserves proximity but omits actual bodily contact, weakening the immediate cause of Shirou’s racing heart.

findings.highlight: this means that Master finally made a move.
findings.evidenceJa: ようやく尻尾を出したってワケか
findings.governingReading: The hidden Master has finally shown their tail and revealed evidence of themselves.
findings.explanation: “Made a move” removes the exposure metaphor and changes revelation of identity/evidence into generic action.

findings.highlight: It seems Tohsaka already knew about this third Master.
findings.evidenceJa: 遠坂はとっくに第三のマスターに気が付いていたらしい。
findings.governingReading: Shirou realizes Rin apparently noticed the third Master long ago.
findings.explanation: “Already” weakens とっくに’s substantial prior duration and Rin’s informational lead.

findings.highlight: her life’s not in danger.
findings.evidenceJa: もう大事はないと思う
findings.governingReading: Rin thinks the girl is probably no longer in serious condition.
findings.explanation: The English narrows 大事 to mortal danger and removes Rin’s explicit uncertainty.

findings.highlight: That means all problems have been resolved.
findings.evidenceJa: これで当面の問題はすべて解決したワケだ。
findings.governingReading: Shirou concludes that all immediate problems are resolved for the time being.
findings.explanation: The English omits 当面 and turns a provisional local assessment into an unqualified resolution.

findings.highlight: sometimes makes the stupidest misunderstandings.
findings.evidenceJa: 時々妙にズレた勘違いをする。
findings.governingReading: Rin sometimes makes strangely off-base or misaligned assumptions.
findings.explanation: “Stupidest” adds a much harsher intelligence judgment and removes the comic idea that her interpretations are oddly misaligned.

findings.highlight: it troubles me
findings.evidenceJa: 男としては色々こまる。
findings.governingReading: At this physical distance and with that expression, Shirou is troubled in several ways specifically as a young man.
findings.explanation: The English removes the gendered attraction frame and reduces his embarrassed reaction to generic trouble.

findings.highlight: You’ll die of necrosis if we leave that wound be. It’ll be my fault if you lose your arm.
findings.evidenceJa: その傷、治療しないと壊死しちゃうじゃない。それで動かなくなったりしたら、わたしの落ち度みたいじゃない
findings.governingReading: Without treatment the wound will necrotize, and if the arm stops functioning Rin will feel as though the fault is hers.
findings.explanation: The English invents Shirou’s death and loss of the arm, replacing functional immobility and Rin’s guarded “it would look like my fault” phrasing.

findings.highlight: Tohsaka pulls at me as if telling me not to talk back.
findings.evidenceJa: つべこべ言うな、とばかりに手を引く遠坂。[lr]
findings.governingReading: This gesture, in which Rin pulls Shirou’s hand as if refusing argument, is semicolon-commented and inactive in the original Japanese.
findings.explanation: mirror moon conditionally restores an obsolete physical gesture absent from the authoritative running script.

findings.highlight: in the residential district on the other side of the town.
findings.evidenceJa: 同じ深山町の中で、俺の家とは正反対の住宅地にある。
findings.governingReading: Rin’s house lies within the same Miyama district, in the residential area diametrically opposite Shirou’s home.
findings.explanation: The English omits Miyama and the explicit relation to Shirou’s house, reducing precise local geography to the other side of town.

findings.highlight: I guess there are Western-style houses at the very top
findings.evidenceJa: 洋風の建物が住宅地の一番上にあるらしい
findings.governingReading: A particular Western-style building apparently stands at the top of the residential district.
findings.explanation: The English pluralizes the landmark into houses and weakens its role as the singular Tohsaka mansion.

findings.highlight: the main base of Tohsaka, a magus with a prestigious lineage.
findings.evidenceJa: 由緒正しい魔術師の家系である、遠坂の本拠地である。
findings.governingReading: The mansion is the headquarters of the Tohsakas, a venerable magus family line.
findings.explanation: The English makes the lineage an attribute of Rin as an individual and obscures the inherited household/family institution.

findings.highlight: I look up at the extravagant mansion, dumbfounded.
findings.evidenceJa: 呆然と洋館を見上げる。
findings.governingReading: Shirou stares dumbfounded up at the Western-style mansion.
findings.explanation: “Extravagant” adds an evaluative architectural detail absent from the source.

findings.highlight: I’m getting nervous just thinking that I’m going into Tohsaka’s house.
findings.evidenceJa: 遠坂の家にお邪魔するって事だけで、妙に緊張してきちまったぞ
findings.governingReading: Shirou becomes strangely nervous merely at the prospect of imposing on or visiting Rin’s home.
findings.explanation: “Going into” removes お邪魔する’s socially self-conscious guest frame, weakening the personal contrast with entering another Master’s base.

findings.highlight: she takes my hand.
findings.evidenceJa: 遠坂は座り込んだ俺の手を取った。
findings.governingReading: Rin takes the hand of Shirou where he sits collapsed on the ground.
findings.explanation: The English preserves the hand-taking but omits his seated/collapsed position, weakening the care and physical imbalance.

findings.highlight: My heart’s pounding.[lr]
findings.evidenceJa: 心臓が大きく脈打っている。
findings.governingReading: After noting palpitations, Shirou separately feels his heart beating powerfully.
findings.explanation: The English uses one pounding-heart line for the preceding sentence and omits this deliberate second pulse of bodily attraction.

findings.highlight: I owe you for another thing.
findings.evidenceJa: また借りができちゃったし
findings.governingReading: Rin has incurred another debt or favor owed to Shirou.
findings.explanation: “Owe you for another thing” is unnatural and obscures the accumulating personal debt that helps end their fight.

findings.highlight: “Hey now.
findings.evidenceJa: 「なんでもなにもないわよ。
findings.governingReading: Rin insists there is no special “why” or ulterior reason for taking him home to treat him.
findings.explanation: “Hey now” does not convey her denial of a particular motive and breaks the guarded logic of her concern.

findings.highlight: I don’t get it at all.
findings.evidenceJa: こっちだってワケわからないじゃない？
findings.governingReading: Shirou protests that if she suddenly says this, he too naturally cannot make sense of it.
findings.explanation: The English keeps confusion but removes こっちだって and the appeal that Rin should recognize his reciprocal bafflement.
